function: Parallel prediction of the next L cascaded BS-RIS-UE channels from past estimated cascaded channels, with decomposition into BS-RIS and RIS-UE parts (p. 1-3).
system: Uplink RIS-aided mmWave MU-MISO: BS with M=4 antennas, K=4 single-antenna UEs, passive reflecting RIS with N=20 to 60 elements (UPA), direct link blocked, 28 GHz (p. 2, 4).
method: Sparse-connected multi-causal convolution attention transformer (SC-MCCATransformer), encoder-decoder, supervised training with NMSE loss, Adam, 100 epochs; one block predicts L channels in parallel (p. 3-4).
data_channel: Own simulator following channel model of [10]: 3 paths each for G and f_k, Doppler shifts, random AoA/AoD; 15,000 training, 3,000 test, 1,000 validation samples (p. 2, 4).
test_conditions: Held-out 3,000-sample test split of the same simulator; sweeps of L (1-5), SNR (0-30 dB), N (20-60) at 30 km/h; training SNR not stated (p. 4-5).
baselines: Learned sequential predictors RNN, GRU and LSTM (Figs. 6-8); no non-learned predictor such as an autoregressive model is simulated (p. 4-5).
metrics: NMSE (dB) of the predicted cascaded channel versus L, SNR and RIS size N; computational complexity in Table II (p. 4-5).
complexity: Order of complexity in Table II: proposed O(K N_L (P(4N^2 + 2N) + 3C^2) + 4KMN + 4MN), compared with RNN, GRU and LSTM (p. 5).
q1_support: p. 4: "The data are generated according to the" model in Eqs. (3)-(4) from [10], a custom multipath simulator with random angles and Doppler (Table I). No 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 4: "samples for the training set, 3,000 for the testing set, and" validation: a held-out part of the same simulated data. Figs. 6-8 sweep L, SNR and N, but no model trained in one condition is tested in another; generalization is left to future retraining (p. 5).
q3_support: p. 4: "with L individual modules in RNN, GRU and LSTM." Figs. 6-8 compare only these learned predictors; no non-learned predictor (for example the autoregressive model of [5], or the outdated channel) is simulated, so the non-learned comparison is missing.
q4_support: p. 5: "Table II succinctly outlines the computational complexity of" the proposed framework and RNN, GRU and LSTM, e.g. O(K N_L (P(4N^2 + 2N) + 3C^2) + 4KMN + 4MN) for the proposed.
q5_support: p. 4: "The dataset comprises 15,000" samples generated by the authors' own simulator (PyTorch implementation). No code or data link is given, and no public or measured dataset is used.
notes: Included, area 2: channel prediction for an RIS-aided MU-MISO system (p. 1-3); RIS has N=20 to 60 passive elements (p. 2, 4). The channel model follows [10], a custom geometric simulator, not a standardized model. q3 is 0 only because no non-learned predictor is simulated, although RNN, GRU and LSTM are compared as learned baselines (Figs. 6-8). Tables I and II and the figure legends were read from the page images (p. 4-5).
